tests.id: lifecycleStepper.test.tsx::LifecycleStepper module > exports no deriveStage execution helper and keeps stageIndex for CLOSED
tests.name: exports no deriveStage execution helper and keeps stageIndex for CLOSED

tests.id: lifecycleStepper.test.tsx::LifecycleStepper module > renders CLOSED as the current step and OPEN as done
tests.name: renders CLOSED as the current step and OPEN as done
tests.title: renders CLOSED as the current step and OPEN as done
tests.scenario: Given status CLOSED, When LifecycleStepper renders, Then the CLOSED li has aria-current='step' and the OPEN li has data-state='done'

units.title: Verify: Docs name devion workseed, match the export keys and avoid removed terms

tests.name: TestHandoffDocs_ReadmeNamesWorkseed
tests.title: backend README names devion workseed
tests.scenario: Given backend/README.md, When its text is read, Then it contains 'devion workseed'

tests.name: TestHandoffDocs_KeysMatchExport
tests.title: handoff doc documents every Export JSON key
tests.scenario: Given an Export holding one ExportContribution, When it is marshaled and decoded into a map, Then each top-level key and each contributions[0] key appears as a quoted key in backend/docs/handoff.md

tests.name: TestHandoffDocs_NoRemovedTerms
tests.title: docs avoid removed worker, execution panel and agent-tool terms
tests.scenario: Given backend/README.md and backend/docs/handoff.md, When their text is lowercased, Then neither contains 'worker', 'executionpanel', 'claude code' or 'cursor'
